responsibility: Implements a large compatibility layer that maps Cell SPU-style intrinsics onto PPU/VMX vector operations. It defines quadword/scalar conversion helpers, arithmetic, logical, permute, shift, compare, control-mask, and memory-load/store routines using VMX vector types and operations, giving software written for SPU intrinsic idioms a PowerPC-side emulation interface built on Altivec/VMX primitives.
